messages.subject: Split split plot ANOVA
parts:
Hi,

I liked Deducer a lot. I've been using it for various statistical
approaches in my experiments. I've an experiment which has split split
plot design. Can I use Deducer for split split plot ANOVA?

Thanks

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Split split plot ANOVA
parts:
No. In general an unbalanced split-split plot design requires linear mixed models (lme) and the balanced case can be done with aov. Niether of these are built into the GUI (you can of course use the command line though).

Best,
ian
